description: This file defines a report parser class for generating a quantity and cost ledger report in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including database query methods and report registration.

classes.name: account_analytic_quantity_cost_ledger
classes.description: Report parser class for handling quantity and cost ledger report logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up local context with helper methods and modules.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches grouped analytic line data by account within a date range, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Fetches analytic line details for a specific general account and account, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _account_sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity for a specific account within a date range, optionally filtered by journals.

methods.name: _sum_quantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity across multiple accounts within a date range, optionally filtered by journals.
